About Us

Your Trusted Taxi Partner in Nagpur

Sagar Tours and Travels is a Nagpur-based taxi and travel service. We handle everyday city rides, airport and railway station transfers, and longer outstation journeys from Nagpur to destinations across Maharashtra and nearby states.

Our focus is straightforward: a clean, comfortable vehicle, a professional driver who knows the route, and a booking process that takes a phone call, a WhatsApp message or a short form. Whether it is a single airport drop or transport for a family trip, the arrangement is the same — you tell us the trip, we confirm the vehicle and the fare.

From compact sedans for solo travellers to MUVs and Tempo Travellers for groups, we match the vehicle to the journey and the number of people travelling, so you are not paying for more car than you need.

  • Based in Nagpur
  • Airport & railway transfers
  • Local & outstation travel
  • Booking support on call

Good to Know

Frequently Asked Questions

Still unsure about something? Call or message us and we will answer directly.

How can I book a taxi in Nagpur?

You can book in three ways: fill in the booking form on this page, send your trip details on WhatsApp, or call us directly. Share your pickup point, destination, date and time, and we will confirm a vehicle for you.

Do you provide airport pickup and drop services?

Yes. We run pickups and drops for Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar International Airport, Nagpur. For arrivals, share your flight number so the driver can adjust to the actual landing time.

Do you provide one-way taxi services?

Yes. One-way trips are available for point-to-point travel, so you only pay for the direction you are travelling instead of a full round trip.

Do you offer outstation taxis from Nagpur?

Yes. We cover outstation travel from Nagpur to destinations across Maharashtra and neighbouring states, on both one-way and round-trip basis.

Can I book a taxi 24/7?

Booking requests are accepted around the clock. Late-night and early-morning trips are easier to arrange when you book a little in advance so a driver can be assigned.

Which payment methods do you accept?

Accepted payment methods have not been confirmed yet and will be listed here shortly. Please confirm the options when you make your booking.

Are tolls and parking charges included?

Tolls, state permits and parking are generally billed separately from the trip fare. Ask for a full breakdown when you receive your quote so you know exactly what is included.

How far in advance should I book?

Same-day bookings are often possible. For airport runs, outstation trips, larger vehicles such as a Tempo Traveller, and travel during festival or wedding season, booking a day or more ahead is safer.

Can I book a taxi for a full-day trip?

Yes. Full-day local use and day trips from Nagpur can be arranged with a vehicle and driver assigned to you for the day.

Do you provide taxis for weddings and events?

Yes. We arrange transportation for weddings, functions and events, including guest pickups and multi-vehicle requirements. Share your dates and expected group size for a suitable plan.
